title: Retail Sales Forecasting and Analysis
description: Forecasts 16 days of unit sales across 54 stores and 33 product families with LightGBM. Evaluates forecasts against a seasonal naive baseline using three chronological backtests.
imageAlt: Retail Fieldnotes dashboard showing sales and store performance
note: LightGBM reduced RMSLE by 27.21% against the seasonal naive baseline.

title: Retail Sales Forecasting and Analysis
description: Analyzes historical demand across 54 stores and 33 product families using DuckDB SQL and Power BI, then forecasts 16 days of unit sales with LightGBM.
imageAlt: Retail Fieldnotes dashboard showing sales and store performance
note: LightGBM reduced RMSLE by 27.21% against a seasonal naive baseline across three chronological backtests.

title: Funnel and Retention Analysis
description: Analysis of the GA4 Google Merchandise Store sample dataset, featuring a Power BI dashboard and a Streamlit app with Groq-powered RAG chat for exploring funnel conversion, retention, acquisition, and data quality.

title: Uber Ride Analytics
description: An analysis of 150,000 NCR ride-booking observations that investigates booking reliability, cancellation patterns, demand peaks, and service performance through 24 SQL analyses and a six-page Power BI dashboard.
imageAlt: Uber Ride Analytics Power BI dashboard showing booking completion, outcomes, and monthly demand
note: Portfolio analysis of a public Kaggle extract; findings describe the supplied dataset.

title: Marketing A/B Testing
description: An A/B test analysis of 588,101 users that evaluates whether product advertising increases conversions against a PSA control, with statistical tests, uncertainty checks, SQL investigation, and a Power BI dashboard.
imageAlt: Marketing A/B testing Power BI dashboard
note: Costs and revenue are unavailable, so the analysis evaluates conversion evidence rather than profitability.

title: Commerce Pulse
description: A historical e-commerce export turned into an interactive SQL explorer, sales dashboards, and an AI analyst grounded in project evidence.
note: Historical sales analysis; valued shipped sales are a proxy, not audited revenue.

title: Developer Technology Trends
description: A reproducible analysis of technology use and future interest in the 2024 Stack Overflow survey, with data cleaning, visualizations, and an interactive dashboard.
note: Desired use reflects survey preferences, not a forecast.

title: Transaction Risk Detector
description: A transaction-risk demonstration using XGBoost, an inference pipeline, and a Flask interface. Evaluates imbalanced data with precision–recall metrics.
note: Educational demo. Free hosting may take a moment to wake up.

title: GlyphDex
description: Read a short line of separate handwritten digits, letters, and supported symbols. A CNN trained on EMNIST and selected HASY classes combines character segmentation, recognition modes, confidence scores, and alternatives for correcting a reading.
imageAlt: GlyphDex handwriting recognition app with mixed-character mode and drawing canvas
note: Designed for spaced, printed characters. Free hosting may take a moment to wake up.

title: FastF1Winner
description: An exploratory race-performance model using FastF1 lap data from the 2024 Australian Grand Prix and gradient boosting to rank drivers against assumed 2025 qualifying times.
imageAlt: FastF1Winner notebook output showing model rankings and mean absolute error
note: Uses assumed qualifying inputs. The repository README credits Akshana Prasad.
